newsitem.title: USA: Windy Hill Pet Food issues $120 mln in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Windy Hill Pet Food issues $120 mln in 144A debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Windy Hill Pet Food Inc was priced Friday via lead manager Chase Securities, according to high-yield market sources.
The debt freed to trade shortly after pricing and was quoted at 101-1/8 bid, 101-1/2 offer late on Friday.
BORROWER WINDY HILL PET FOOD CO INC
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 11/15/97
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 9.75 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS CALLABLE NON CALL FIVE
NOTE: Three year equity call for 35 percent at par plus coupon
